remarks: Welcome to Old Orchard in the heart of Valencia, where lifestyle isn't just a perk, it's built into the neighborhood. Tucked inside one of Santa Clarita's most sought-after communities, this beautifully positioned upper end unit condo delivers comfort, convenience, and a little extra breathing room. And let's talk about what makes this one stand out: no one above you or below you, with only 1 shared wall you are greeted with just peace, privacy, natural light and courtyard views framed by mature trees and lush landscaping.
